problem.read: The server didn't answer as expected. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not see or do this.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.notEnough: That stock is not there any more: stock never goes below zero. Read the figures again.
problem.notNow: This cannot be done in its present state.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.noPermission: Your role does not include “{permission}”. Ask an administrator if you need this page.

wait.rejected: Rejected: it leaves the stock (returned or scrapped).
wait.blocked: Blocked by quality: it cannot be issued.
wait.crViFailed: Cr VI at or above the limit: it can never be issued.
wait.crVi: Waits for its Cr VI result: its stock cannot be issued.

held.noReverse: Your role may not reverse moves.
held.isReversal: This move is itself a reversal.
held.fromPickList: An issue or a return is reversed from its work order's pick list.
held.fromReceipt: A receipt's moves are reversed with the whole receipt (Warehouse › Receipts).
held.opening: Opening stock is corrected with an adjustment, never reversed.
held.offline: Offline: changes wait until the connection is back.
